title: PlasmaQuick::Dialogs are inappropriately translucent if kwin blur effect is disabled
line: With the Blur effect off, Plasma popups, Application Menu submenus and tooltips are now opaque instead of showing the desktop through them.
explanation: Breeze has two versions of the dialog and tooltip backgrounds: one in translucent/ used when the Blur effect is available, and a regular one used without blur. Both were drawn at 85% opacity, so with blur the background is blurred and looks solid, but without blur the same popups showed icons and text from behind them unblurred, which is what reporters saw in Kicker submenus, tooltips and folder popups. The change makes the regular (no-blur) dialogs/background and widgets/tooltip fills opaque, like the solid/ variants; the blur variants are untouched.

commits.message:
desktoptheme/breeze: make dialogs and tooltips opaque without blur

The regular dialog and tooltip backgrounds were as translucent as the
ones used with blur, so without blur popups showed whatever was behind
them unblurred. Use opaque fills there, matching the solid variants.

BUG: 481595

media.caption: Blur off: the Development submenu (and the main menu) show the wallpaper and favorites icons through them
Blur off, with the fix: submenu and main menu are opaque
Blur off: the panel tooltip shows the desktop text behind it
Blur off, with the fix: the tooltip is opaque

review.text: SVG-only change to Breeze's regular (no-blur) dialog and tooltip backgrounds, along the lines cwo suggested in c23: popups are no longer see-through when blur is off, and the blurred translucent/ variants are untouched. The before/after shots of the Kicker submenu and the tooltip show it, and enabling blur again keeps the old look. It is a visible design change for everyone without blur, so the VDG/maintainers should agree to it in the MR; third-party themes keep their own behaviour.
